subtitle: Connections, Hooks, and provider packages, used together

eyebrow: What goes in a Snowflake Connection

code:
refresh_orders_summary = SnowflakeOperator(
    task_id="refresh_orders_summary",
    snowflake_conn_id="snowflake_default",
    sql="""
        CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE analytics.orders_summary AS
        SELECT order_date, COUNT(*) AS order_count,
               SUM(order_total) AS revenue
        FROM raw.orders GROUP BY order_date;
    """,
)
caption: Scheduled daily at 6 AM — the same SQL you'd run by hand.
Same Connection, more control over what happens with the result.
